newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower at 1,023.80.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower at 1,023.80.

text.p: Colombia's peso snapped a three-day winning streak to end 1.8 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,023.80, interbank dealers said.

They said the peso's weakeness was due, at least in part, to moves by banks and other financial institutions taking advantage of the local currency's close at its highest level since Feb. 6 to cover short dollar positions.
Traders said there was no sign of pent-up demand for dollars in the corporate sector, however, and the peso was widely expected to trend upwards again next week.
Dealers reported 280 trades in Friday's session for a total of $104 million and said the peso held in a 1,021.00 to 1,024.95 range.
